fixer.title: sessions: stop the activity bar from rechecking pull request openers on every state update

introducer.title: sessions: stabilize and toggle the default PR activity action

cases.mechanism: Equivalent pull-request URIs reconstructed on session state updates failed structural equality, repeatedly invalidating the activity-bar opener derivation. Each invalidation spawned a concurrent opener lookup for every PR and every contributed opener, cancelling in-flight requests and potentially logging those cancellation failures.
cases.symptom: High-frequency session updates caused repeated and cancelled extension-host canOpen IPC and associated cancellation-log churn, scaling with update frequency, pull-request references, and registered openers.
cases.fixedBehavior: The new equality function compares each stable artifact id and URI value with resources.isEqual, so equivalent reconstructed links no longer invalidate activityBarOpeners. Real id/link changes plus extension/configuration signals still trigger revalidation, preserving intended refresh semantics while removing repeated opener discovery, cancellation, and extension-host IPC.
cases.evidence: Base line 629 used structuralEquals for arrays containing URI instances. structuralEquals only recursively compares arrays and plain objects, so a state refresh that recreates an equivalent URI makes activityBarOpenerRefs look changed. That invalidates activityBarOpeners, cancels its prior token, and reruns Promise.all(refs.map(...externalUriOpenerService.getOpener...)). getOpener calls getValidOpeners, which invokes every registered opener's canOpen concurrently; MainThreadUriOpeners implements canOpen with proxy.$canOpenUri, an extension-host IPC. The added test recreates identical links ten times and now observes zero additional lookups.
